title: Dehumidifier for Basement, 95 Pint
amazon_match_notes: Exact ASIN B0CYT7XY5V match: HUMILABS model OL35-D076E, a 95-pint/day dehumidifier (13.98"W x 10.83"D x 20.55"H, 5.3 L tank). Home Depot lists the same factory unit as Edendirect FXIOJE082050P and states FXIOJE082050P = OL35-D076E with identical dimensions.

comparisons.notes: Edendirect FXIOJE082050P; listing states 'Model# FXIOJE082050P = OL35-D076E'; 95 pt/day, 20.55x13.98x10.83 in, 5L tank, 2 fan speeds, white. Rebadge of the same factory model as HUMILABS OL35-D076E. Page showed price and returns, no out-of-stock notice (no explicit in-stock text).

writeup: Woot has the HUMILABS OL35-D076E 95-pint-per-day basement dehumidifier for $90.99. The unit measures 13.98 inches wide by 10.83 inches deep by 20.55 inches high, with a 5.3 liter tank, auto defrost, a 24-hour timer, and a drain hose. Home Depot sells the same factory model under the Edendirect brand as FXIOJE082050P — the listing states FXIOJE082050P equals OL35-D076E — for $437.18, so this is 79 percent below that price and saves about $346. Quantity is capped, with at least one left and a limit of one per customer.
